metadata.description: Rural retirement property candidates for Chris and Becky

affordability.notes: Asking price is at the current ceiling. Cash-to-close, insurance, rehabilitation exposure, taxes and financing terms remain unverified; advertised terms are Cash or Other with no confirmed owner financing.

qualification.exceptionReason: At the $150,000 ceiling with no verified acquisition solution or full-time RV approval, but the local 2.4-acre AR2 parcel, legal residential footprint, existing utilities, no HOA and useful outbuildings make it a serious candidate.
exceptionalStrengths: 2.4 acres in Brooksville with no HOA and AR2 zoning
Existing manufactured home, connected electricity, well and septic
Two sheds, cleared usable ground and a much better New Port Richey commute

confirmed: Active Stellar MLS listing W7887839 at $149,900 checked on 2026-10-23
2.4-acre AR2 parcel with no HOA advertised
1982 double-wide with 1,568 square feet and a metal roof
Well with a recently replaced pump, septic and connected electricity are advertised
Two sheds and substantial cleared area are advertised
FEMA Zone X is reported by current listing sources
Property is being sold as-is and priced primarily for the land and existing infrastructure
unknowns: Whether the manufactured home is legally habitable, condemned, or subject to an open demolition order
Open Hernando County code-enforcement cases, permits, liens and unsafe-structure findings
Interior condition because the seller does not permit interior showings
Whether the septic system is operational, correctly sized and legally reusable rather than merely present
Current well-water quality, flow and permit status
Insurance eligibility and true rehabilitation or removal cost
Whether full-time occupancy of Grace is allowed before, during or instead of rehabilitating the dwelling
Driveway width, overhead clearance, bearing capacity and turning room for a 40-foot, 26,000-pound RV
Owner financing, assumable debt, delayed closing or other workable acquisition terms
Deed restrictions, outdoor-storage rules, visible-neighbor screening and gate placement
Internet service, evacuation access, wetland boundaries and survey accuracy
research.notes: Top local lead. Do not spend inspection or closing money until county records confirm there is no condemnation or demolition order and the existing residential and utility footprint can legally support the Grace plan.

affordability.notes: The $249,999 asking price is far above the current target. Owner financing is advertised for qualified buyers, but down payment, interest rate, amortization, balloon, prepayment terms, taxes after sale and insurance remain unknown.

qualification.exceptionReason: The asking price is well above target and full-time RV occupancy is unverified, but this is an unusually complete setup with a legal residential footprint, existing utilities, a new permitted septic system, RV hookup, fencing, powered workshop, barns, carport and advertised owner financing.
exceptionalStrengths: 2.7 AG-zoned acres across two parcels, fully fenced and without an HOA
Connected electricity, private well and a permitted 2025 septic system sized for four bedrooms
Existing 30-amp RV hookup, powered workshop, seven-stall powered horse barn and four-bay powered carport
Owner financing advertised for qualified buyers

confirmed: Active Stellar MLS listing TB8534333 at $249,999 checked on 2026-10-28
2.7 acres across two advertised parcels with AG zoning and no HOA
Fully fenced property with a new entrance gate
2018 Champion one-bedroom trailer with connected electricity and private well
Permitted septic system and drain field installed in 2025 and advertised as sized for four bedrooms
Existing 30-amp RV hookup
Large workshop or barn with electricity and water; listing says the workshop tools convey
Seven-stall horse barn with electricity and water plus a four-bay powered carport
FEMA Zone X reported by current listing sources
Owner financing advertised for qualified buyers
unknowns: Owner-financing down payment, interest rate, amortization, balloon, prepayment and closing terms
Whether the trailer title, age, permits and legal occupancy status match the listing description
Whether Hernando County allows Grace to be occupied full-time at the existing RV hookup
Well-water quality, flow, equipment condition and permit history
Septic inspection results, permit closeout and exact connection capacity
Survey confirmation that both advertised parcels convey and provide the expected usable dimensions
Extent and practical effect of the advertised conservation area
Driveway clearance, turning room, bearing capacity and hookup placement for a 40-foot, 26,000-pound RV
Visibility from the road and neighboring homes at the intended Grace parking location
Insurance eligibility, post-sale taxes, deed restrictions, outdoor-storage rules and internet service
research.notes: Top complete-setup lead despite the price. Get written owner-financing terms and county confirmation of Grace's full-time occupancy before spending money on inspections or treating the existing RV hookup as approval to live there.

affordability.notes: The $184,500 asking price exceeds the current ceiling. One current broker page advertises owner financing while Zillow lists Cash, so no acquisition solution exists until the seller provides written terms. Taxes, insurance, demolition or rebuilding costs and utility repairs remain unknown.

qualification.exceptionReason: The asking price is above target, power and flood status are unknown, and the partially demolished mobile home could hide a code or condemnation mess. It remains worth tracking because the local AG-zoned acreage has no HOA, privacy fencing, well, septic, paid impact fees, sheds and possible owner financing.
exceptionalStrengths: 2.3 cleared AG-zoned acres in a familiar rural Brooksville area with no HOA
Existing well, septic system and reportedly paid impact fees
Fenced and privacy-fenced features plus existing sheds
Current broker page advertises owner financing

confirmed: Active Hernando County MLS listing 2261341 at $184,500 checked on 2026-10-29
2.3 cleared acres with AG zoning and no HOA advertised
Existing well, septic system and paid impact fees advertised
Older mobile home remains in place with its interior partially demolished
Listing reports fencing and privacy fencing, while its description calls the fencing partial
Existing sheds and other structures advertised
Asphalt county-road frontage advertised
Broker page says owner financing is available; Zillow currently lists Cash
unknowns: Written confirmation that owner financing is actually offered and its down payment, rate, amortization, balloon, prepayment and closing terms
Whether the mobile home is legally habitable or rebuildable, condemned, or subject to an unsafe-structure or demolition order
Open Hernando County code-enforcement cases, permits, liens and demolition requirements
Whether the existing mobile-home footprint, paid impact fees and utility connections remain legally reusable
Electrical-service presence, meter status, reconnection requirements and repair cost
Well-water quality, flow, equipment condition and permit history
Septic condition, capacity, permit status and legal reuse
FEMA flood zone, wetlands and actual high-and-dry usable acreage
Whether Hernando County allows Grace to be occupied full-time during demolition, rebuilding or instead of the mobile home
Driveway clearance, turning room, bearing capacity and parking layout for a 40-foot, 26,000-pound RV
Exact fence coverage, gate condition, survey boundaries, deed restrictions, outdoor-storage rules and internet service
research.notes: Serious local project candidate because the fenced AG acreage, well, septic, paid impact fees and neighborhood culture fit the mission. Do not spend inspection or closing money until written financing terms and county records confirm there is no condemnation, demolition order, code lien or blocked utility reuse.
